title: Employer payroll taxes and worker status — Bramble Design
instructions: Compute Bramble Design's 2025 employer payroll taxes and classify its workers. The Social Security wage base is **$176,100**; Bramble receives the full 5.4% FUTA credit. Round to the nearest dollar.

rows.label: Employer Medicare tax
rows.explanation: 240,000 × 1.45% = **3,480**; the employer doesn't pay the 0.9% add-on.

rows.label: A designer who works set hours at Bramble's office using Bramble's equipment, trained by Bramble
rows.explanation: Behavioral and financial control indicate employment.

rows.label: A photographer who bids per project, uses her own equipment, serves many clients and invoices Bramble
rows.explanation: She controls how the work is done and bears profit or loss.
